plugins.title: Block plugins
plugins.consent: Enabled plugins run as your user. Enable only executables you trust. Changed commands or permissions require fresh approval.
plugins.empty: No plugins installed in your Ferryx configuration directory.

wizard.title: Welcome to Ferryx
wizard.reopenHint: You can reopen this from Settings > Permissions.

account.title: Sign in
account.heading: Sign in to Ferryx
account.lede: Optional. Sign in with your email and this computer is linked to your account, so you can open its worktrees from your phone.

intro.title: Welcome
intro.heading: Set up Ferryx
intro.lede: A short tour and setup. Signing in comes last and is optional.

features.title: Features
features.heading: What Ferryx does
features.lede: The parts you'll use every day.

agents.title: Agents
agents.heading: Choose your default agent
agents.lede: New agent tabs start with this one. You can switch per tab, or change it later in Settings > Agents.

cli.title: Command line
cli.heading: Install the command-line tool
cli.lede: Optional. Use ferryx from any terminal. You can also install it later in Settings > General.

project.title: First project
project.heading: Open your first project
project.lede: Start with a folder on this computer, or pair another machine.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.heading: Let the supervisor run your work
supervisor.lede: Optional. Turn it on once and it picks up requests, runs them in your projects, and checks in when it needs you.

try.title: First worktree
try.heading: Try your first worktree
try.lede: Optional. A worktree is an isolated checkout of your project with its own branch and agent tab.

phone.title: Phone
phone.heading: Connect your phone
phone.lede: Optional. Pair your phone to follow and answer agents away from your desk.
